notes.title: Re Release of both the Demo and Full Game versions
notes.notes:
Immersive-Games are happy to announce that both the Demo and Full Game versions of the game have been re released, thanks to very constructive feedback.

New features:

Signage has been uncovered by the solar winds to make it easier to find the Sphere Deposits.

A floating sign is visible from space has been discovered, that marks the location of the Sphere Deposits on the infrared radar.

Additional time has been added to the Demo version of the game
